stem:
Meera wants to measure how long three different events take. She must choose a suitable unit of time for each event.

Which choice of unit is the most suitable for measuring each event?

options.text: The time to blink an eye in hours
The time taken to boil milk in minutes
The duration of a school day in seconds
The time to run 100 m in minutes

teacher.key_rationale: Boiling milk typically takes several minutes, so minutes is the suitable unit (B). A blink lasts a fraction of a second, not hours (A). A school day is many hours, making seconds unwieldy (C). A 100 m run takes seconds, so minutes is unsuitable (D).
